pattern: 思いをする（おもいをする）
purpose: Describe undergoing an emotionally colored experience.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
い-adjective / な-adjective + な + 思いをする
I had a frightening experience on the dark road.
I felt embarrassed after getting the name wrong.
Their kindness gave me a happy experience.
formation: い-adjective / な-adjective + な + 思いをする
restrictions: Typical adjectives describe difficulty, fear, embarrassment, or pleasure.
mistake: It describes an experience that gives rise to the feeling, not just an opinion.
